column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test -race` (CHAOS-6690), the weight
# ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the race shards by. Only packages of 20 s or more are
# listed; every other package weighs the awk default. The weights only need to be
# roughly right: a stale one costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition
# the full package list). Key = import path relative to the module root. Sorted (LC_ALL=C),
# no duplicates; tests/tooling/test_go_race_shards.py checks each row names a real package.
